text:
aj_support: Heads-up — PulseLabs (trial, mid-market) just opened a P1 for onboarding. Embeddings provisioning failing across their region; they hit this during a live demo. Renewal window in ~7 days, risk = high. Dropping logs and short notes below.

aj_support: error seen: POST /v1/embeddings -> 500 
```
ERROR: kv-store timeout when provisioning tenant pulse-123
Trace: org.redwood.infra.ProvisionException: quotaExceeded
```

aj_support: tried re-provision + cache flush, also attempted fallback to smaller model variant (r-embed-mini) — still 500.

maria_cs: Acked. Thanks for flagging, @aj_support. I'm taking point from CS. Can you share the customer contact who was on the demo and their preferred time zone? Need to assemble SW/SE + enablement.

aj_support: Contact is Sara Li (sara@pulselabs.com), PST. Demo was 30m ago. They were using the hosted API via our us-west region.

maria_cs: OK. This looks like a provisioning quota race — PulseLabs ramped requests during setup. I'll mark as priority-handback and schedule an immediate enablement session.

oliver_se: Quick workaround: if you patch tenant config to set `provision_throttle_ms: 250` and retry, the backend avoids the kv-store contention for now. Example mutation:
```
PATCH /v1/tenants/pulse-123/config
{
  "provision_throttle_ms": 250
}
```
I can apply with permission; it will be reversible.

aj_support: @oliver_se please apply and confirm. Also we need an outbound comms plan to the customer within 30m.

oliver_se: Applied. Did a test embed call, got 200. Logs: keyspace alloc success.

sam_oncall: Noted. I'll watch infra metrics and set an alert if kv-store latency > 150ms. Linking the playbook: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/provisioning-contention

devon_pm: Maria — for comms, recommend this short plan: 1) Apologize + immediate mitigation applied 2) Offer 1:1 enablement session in next 24h + temp SLA credit if needed 3) Follow-up post-mortem with root cause + fix ETA. Can CS own step 1 & 2?

maria_cs: Yes, CS will own step 1 & 2. I'll send a 15m triage call invite to Sara and include @oliver_se and @aj_support. Draft message to send to customer: 
"Hi Sara — I'm Maria from Redwood CS. We're aware of the interruption during your demo and have applied a temporary mitigation. Can we hop on a 15-min call in the next 30 mins to walk through a safe retry and schedule a longer enablement session?"

aj_support: That looks good. Add: "We're prioritizing your account while we complete a root-cause analysis."

maria_cs: Added. Sending now.

incbot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-4589. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-4589. Severity P1 (onboarding-impact).

maria_cs: Post-call notes: Sara accepted 15m in 20m. We confirmed workaround works client-side. Customer very sensitive given renewal. Requested written summary and action items. Assigning follow-ups: 
- CS: written comms + schedule enablement (maria_cs)
- SE: finalize config hardening steps and runbook (oliver_se)
- PM: track fix rollout and public ETA (devon_pm)
- Oncall: monitor infra & update ticket (sam_oncall)

aj_support: Thanks — I updated support ticket with the comms and linked to the incident. Also capturing notes from demo logs.

maria_cs: We'll send a recap to Sara after the enablement session and flag renewal team if we see churn signals. I'll capture feedback and any friction points from the demo.

oliver_se: I'll draft the runbook and push a config patch to staging for verification. ETA 4 hours.

devon_pm: I'll create a rollout ticket and schedule the QA window. Will ping here when we have ETA.

sam_oncall: Alerts set, dashboard pinned to incident. Will post updates on any regrowth in error rate.

maria_cs: Great coordination team. I'll follow up with a summary and next steps in INC-2026-4589 after the enablement. :thumbsup:
